hero.sub: Your team goes home at 6. Your leads don't stop submitting forms. We build automated email and SMS sequences that keep every lead warm, every appointment confirmed, and every no-show recovered - 24/7, across every location.

why.title: Most Franchise Leads Die From Neglect, Not Rejection.
why.body: Most people who say "no" to a franchise don't actually say no. They go quiet. They get busy. They forget they ever submitted the form. Industry data shows 80% of sales happen between the 5th and 12th touch - but most franchisees give up after 2. We build email and SMS sequences that follow up for you, consistently, across every lead, every day of the week - without burning out your team or annoying your prospects.

introHeader.title: Automated Nurture Sequences for Every Stage
introHeader.body: From the moment a lead submits a form to the day they become a paying customer, every touchpoint is automated and optimized.

features.eyebrow: Welcome Them Before They Cool Off
features.title: New Lead Confirmation Sequence
features.paragraph: The moment a lead hits submit, they're at peak intent. If they don't hear back from you in the next 5 minutes, that intent drops off a cliff. We build an instant email + SMS confirmation sequence that fires the second a form comes in: thanks them by name, confirms their inquiry, and drops a direct booking link into their inbox. No waiting. No wondering if it went through. Just a clear next step.

bullets.label: Dual-channel confirmation
bullets.rest: via email and SMS within 60 seconds of form submission

bullets.label: Personalized merge fields
bullets.rest: that reference the exact service or location they inquired about

bullets.label: Direct booking link
bullets.rest: in every message so they can self-schedule on the spot

features.title: Appointment Reminder Flow
features.paragraph: No-shows are a silent killer for franchise businesses. Every missed appointment is wasted time, wasted ad spend, and a missed membership sale. We build multi-touch reminder sequences that fire at exactly the right moments: 24 hours before, 1 hour before, and 5 minutes before. Each reminder gives them a chance to confirm, reschedule, or cancel. The result: no-show rates drop by 30-40% within the first month.

bullets.label: 1-hour SMS reminder
bullets.rest: for the final push before the appointment

bullets.label: 5-minute SMS
bullets.rest: with directions, parking info, and what to bring

features.eyebrow: Turn Missed Appointments Into Second Chances
features.title: No-Show Recovery Sequence
features.paragraph: Even with perfect reminders, some prospects still miss appointments. Life happens. Most franchises treat this as a dead lead and move on. We don't. We fire an automated recovery sequence within 15 minutes of a missed appointment: empathetic tone, easy rebooking link, no pressure. About 35-45% of no-shows end up rebooking when the follow-up is fast and low-friction, which means every franchisee gets a second shot at conversion without any extra work.

bullets.label: 15-minute recovery trigger
bullets.rest: that fires the moment an appointment is marked as missed

bullets.label: Empathetic messaging templates
bullets.rest: that reduce friction and avoid coming across as pushy

bullets.label: One-click rebooking link
bullets.rest: that lets them pick a new time on the spot

features.eyebrow: For Leads Who Aren't Ready Yet
features.title: Long-Term Nurture Sequences
features.paragraph: Not every lead is ready to buy today. Some are researching, some are waiting for payday, some are just curious. The brands that win are the ones that stay top-of-mind without being annoying. We build 90-day email nurture sequences that educate, entertain, and slowly build trust - so when they're ready to buy, your brand is the first one they think of. Content is modular per franchise vertical and customized to your brand voice.

bullets.label: Behavioral triggers
bullets.rest: that re-engage dormant leads based on email activity

bullets.label: Re-engagement campaigns
bullets.rest: that activate at 30, 60, and 90 days of silence

features.eyebrow: Turn Happy Clients Into Social Proof
features.title: Automated Review Requests
features.paragraph: Google reviews are one of the highest-leverage assets a franchise location can build. Prospects read them before booking, search engines rank by them, and they compound over time. But most franchisees never ask for them consistently. We automate the ask: timed review requests that fire at the perfect post-visit moment, with one-click links straight to your Google Business Profile. The result: review count compounds month over month, and your star rating keeps climbing.

bullets.label: Perfectly-timed post-visit prompts
bullets.rest: sent when client satisfaction is highest

bullets.label: Direct-to-Google links
bullets.rest: that remove all friction from leaving a review

bullets.label: Negative feedback capture
bullets.rest: that routes unhappy clients to an internal team first

features.title: Performance Tracking & Optimization
features.paragraph: Running sequences without tracking them is just expensive guesswork. We track every touchpoint across every sequence: open rates, click rates, response rates, and ultimate conversion to booked appointments. When a message performs well, we double down. When a sequence fatigues, we refresh it. Every franchise location's data rolls up into a single dashboard, so you always know exactly what's working across your network.

bullets.label: Per-message analytics
bullets.rest: covering open, click, and response rates

bullets.label: Sequence-level conversion tracking
bullets.rest: tied to booked appointments and revenue

bullets.label: Continuous A/B testing
bullets.rest: that evolves sequences as audiences and seasons shift
